themes_detail.label: Dead animal complaints up
themes_detail.summary: Elmhurst/South Corona experienced a 700% spike in dead animal complaints this week (9 complaints vs. 1.1 weekly average), signaling a potential public health or sanitation failure that warrants immediate investigation into cause and cleanup response.
evidence: 9 dead animal complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 7.48)
Represents 700% spike from baseline — statistically significant anomaly
High severity rating and recent timing suggest acute event rather than chronic issue
reporting_angles: Interview Sanitation Department about potential causes (disease outbreak, rodent infestation, infrastructure failure affecting animal populations)
Document response times and community health risks; check if residents are reporting health concerns alongside animal sightings

themes_detail.label: Encampment Surge
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints nearly quadrupled this week (17 complaints vs. 3.9 weekly average), representing a 339% spike that aligns with long-standing community board requests for homeless services and suggests a deteriorating street-level strain in the district.
evidence: 17 encampment complaints THIS WEEK vs. 3.9 weekly average (z-score: 6.29)
339% spike from 8-week baseline — fourth-highest statistical anomaly in data
Homeless Person Assistance complaints also up 149% this week (14 vs. 5.6 avg), suggesting concurrent service demand
Community board has submitted repeated budget requests for DHS services and homeless support — unmet need documented
reporting_angles: Map encampment locations and interview residents on safety/quality-of-life impact; connect to broader Queens homelessness trends
Why are DHS budget requests recurring? Interview community board and city on what resources are missing and what prompted this week's spike

themes_detail.label: Graffiti Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Graffiti complaints surged 1100% three weeks ago (30 complaints vs. 2.5 weekly average), representing the highest statistical anomaly in the district's 311 data, though timing is slightly older; this warrants verification of whether the spike is ongoing or resolved.
evidence: 30 graffiti complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs. 2.5 weekly average (z-score: 14.7 — highest anomaly in dataset)
1100% spike — suggests coordinated vandalism event or tag crew activity rather than baseline disorder
Spike timing is 3 weeks old; recency is lower but statistical severity is extreme
reporting_angles: Verify if graffiti spike was one-time event or ongoing; check NYPD/Parks Department records for coordinated enforcement response
Interview Parks and Sanitation on cleanup backlog and whether this correlates with known vandalism crews or gang activity

themes_detail.label: Homeless Assistance Demand Surge
themes_detail.summary: Homeless Person Assistance complaints jumped 149% this week (14 complaints vs. 5.6 weekly average), mirroring the encampment spike and reflecting a concentrated stress moment in street-level social services capacity.
evidence: 14 homeless assistance complaints THIS WEEK vs. 5.6 weekly average (z-score: 5.31)
149% spike from baseline — fifth-highest statistical anomaly
Occurs in same week as encampment spike, suggesting synchronized acute event or service collapse moment
reporting_angles: Interview DHS and local nonprofits on what triggered surge in assistance requests; are outreach workers responding adequately?
Profile individual cases: what are residents asking 311 for? (shelter, mental health services, food access?)

themes_detail.label: Sanitation Worker Complaints Spike
themes_detail.summary: Sanitation Worker and Vehicle complaints exploded 1100% last week (3 complaints vs. 0.2 weekly average), indicating a potential service quality or conduct issue that may reflect broader departmental strain in the district.
evidence: 3 sanitation worker/vehicle complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average (z-score: 6.35)
1100% spike — tied for second-highest anomaly magnitude in dataset
Timing is last week, not this week, so slightly less current than other spikes
reporting_angles: What were the three complaints about? (conduct, missed pickups, vehicle damage?) — request 311 complaint details
Interview Sanitation Department on staffing, routes, and whether workforce issues are affecting service in Elmhurst/South Corona
